sn2.28:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Nandivisālo devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn2.28:2.1: Catucakkaṃ navadvāraṃ || puṇṇam lobhena saṃyutaṃ || paṅkajātaṃ mahāvīra || kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatīti ||
sn2.28:3.1: Chetvā nandiṃ varattañ ca || icchālobhañ ca pāpakaṃ || samūlaṃ taṇham abbuyha || evaṃ yātrā bhavissatīti || ||
